title: AI event, schema version 2
description: What the backend publishes since 2026-09-16: an envelope any consumer can route, deduplicate, trace and version-check without understanding the payload, around a payload whose shape depends on eventType. Version 2 because moving the fields into `payload` is a breaking change from version 1 (contracts/ai-events/v1), which consumers still accept; see docs/EVENT_SCHEMA.md. Produced by com.skillbridge.shared.messaging.EventEnvelope; read by skillbridge-ai-service/ai_event_contract.py::parse_event. The schema is strict (no unlisted fields) so that adding a field is a reviewed change to this file; consumers are tolerant readers, which is what lets such an addition ship without a version bump.

eventId.description: Unique per event, and equal to the AMQP message_id. What consumers deduplicate on. A replay gets a new one.

eventType.description: Which handler runs, and which payload shape follows.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this event type's payload. This file describes version 2 only; a consumer that meets a version it does not support must refuse the message loudly, not guess.

occurredAt.description: When the business change happened, UTC, ISO-8601 with a Z. Not when it was published: the relay may send it minutes later.

aggregateType.description: The kind of thing that changed.

aggregateId.description: Which one. A string, whatever the key's type in the database.

collegeId.description: The tenant, so a consumer can scope what it does. Null only for an event that belongs to no college.

traceId.description: The correlation id of the request that caused the event, or null if there was none (a scheduled job).

replayOf.description: Present only on a replay from the dead-letter queue: the eventId of the event it re-sends.

payload.description: The event itself. Its shape is chosen by eventType; see the rules below.

SkillUpdated.description: A student added a skill or changed its proficiency. Version 1 carried skillId in metadata.

ProfileUpdated.description: A student changed profile fields the analysis reads.
